tagline: Four animal flatmates. One tiny London flat. Zero chill.
format: Standalone sitcom gag, 30-50s, punchline in the final shot, ending loops back to the opening frame.
style_prompt: high-quality 3D animated feature-film style, soft rounded character shapes, expressive faces with clear mouth movement for dialogue, adult sitcom framing, warm muted palette of terracotta, teal and mustard, soft cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, vertical 9:16 composition with subject centred, no text, no subtitles, no logos
audio_prompt: clean dialogue, light sitcom room tone, subtle comedic sound effects, no background music (music is added in post)
negative_prompt: photorealistic humans, gore, text overlays, watermarks, brand logos, extra limbs, distorted faces, toddler or baby characters, nursery rhyme style

dougie.name: Dougie
dougie.ref_prompt: anthropomorphic golden retriever man in his late twenties, fluffy golden fur, big hopeful brown eyes, floppy ears, always-wagging tail, wearing an oversized navy hoodie and a bright red work lanyard, white trainers, stands upright on two legs
dougie.personality: relentless optimist, junior sales rep at a mattress showroom, overshares, treats every day as a 'big day', terrible at hiding emotions (tail gives him away)
dougie.voice: warm, fast, excitable young adult male, light London accent

margo.name: Margo
margo.ref_prompt: anthropomorphic grey tabby cat woman in her early thirties, sharp green eyes behind round tortoiseshell glasses, neat cream cardigan over a white collared shirt, slim grey trousers, holding a label maker or a mug, stands upright on two legs, composed posture
margo.personality: deadpan accountant, runs the flat like a spreadsheet, label-maker obsessed, secretly the most chaotic of them all
margo.catchphrase: I have a spreadsheet for this.
margo.voice: dry, low, unimpressed adult female, crisp British accent

pidge.name: Pidge
pidge.ref_prompt: anthropomorphic city pigeon man in his mid twenties, iridescent green-purple neck feathers, cocky half-lidded orange eyes, backwards baseball cap, fluorescent yellow hi-vis delivery vest over a grey t-shirt, tiny scooter helmet clipped to his belt, stands upright on two legs
pidge.personality: delivery rider with nine side hustles, always broke, speaks in hustle-culture jargon, eats anything, surprisingly loyal
pidge.catchphrase: It's not a scam, it's a business model.
pidge.voice: quick, cocky, streetwise young adult male, strong London accent

sloane.name: Sloane
sloane.ref_prompt: anthropomorphic three-toed sloth of indeterminate age, shaggy brown-beige fur, permanent serene half-smile, dark eye patches, mustard yellow beanie, oversized cream hoodie, carries a slim laptop, moves very slowly, stands upright on two legs
sloane.personality: freelancer nobody understands the job of, speaks extremely slowly, never panics, always wins by accident
sloane.voice: very slow, calm, mellow, warm low voice, relaxed delivery with long pauses

mrs_badger.name: Mrs Badger
mrs_badger.ref_prompt: anthropomorphic elderly badger woman, black and white striped face, small sharp eyes, pink hair curlers, floral quilted dressing gown, fluffy slippers, holding a clipboard, stands upright on two legs
mrs_badger.personality: landlady who lives upstairs, obsessed with rules and inspections, appears suddenly from nowhere, secretly soft-hearted
mrs_badger.voice: older female, stern, clipped, northern English accent
